description: This file implements the DataInputTab component for managing data input values associated with a specific asset and input parameter in a front-end React application. It includes state management, API interactions, modal dialogs for editing/creating data input values, and data table presentation.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the latest data input values for the selected asset and input parameter and updates the component state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes the form for creating a new data input value and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with existing data input value details for editing and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates form input and initiates creation or update of a data input value via API calls, providing user feedback and reloading data.
